Task complete. Summary:

- Wrote `out/T4/solution.py`: a standalone PyTorch/safetensors script that
  - opens the (sharded) base checkpoint and the two single-file fine-tunes via `safetensors.safe_open`, handling the index-based sharding transparently,
  - verifies all three checkpoints share the same tensor names and that every tensor outside the 48 MLP tensors (gate/up/down proj weights × 16 layers) is bit-identical across all three, aborting loudly otherwise,
  - computes `base + λ(ft1−base) + λ(ft2−base)` with λ=0.4 in float32 for each of the 48 MLP tensors, taken against the unmodified base (no ordering hazard),
  - copies the other 66 tensors from base unchanged,
  - asserts exactly 48 merged / 114 total tensors before and after writing, then writes `out/T4/model.safetensors`.
- Ran it once with `.venv/bin/python out/T4/solution.py` — it succeeded on the first execution, producing a 114-tensor file with correct shapes/dtypes.
- Wrote `out/T4/REPORT.md` with the participant self-report (1 execution, no failures).
